title: Quirónsalud notifies patient-portal users of unauthorised access that took their email address
date_note: Date of the access as stated in the Quirónsalud notice quoted by El Digital de Albacete (published 21 November).
geo_basis: country; the article does not say which centres or city are affected
summary: El Digital de Albacete reports that a notice in Quirónsalud's Portal del Paciente says unauthorised access on 16 November extracted users' email address. elDiario.es reports, citing company sources, that clinical data was not accessed, the web portal in Colombia was targeted, and the attack was AI-assisted using an "ARTEX AI" framework. The company calls it contained and says it told the security forces and the data protection agency. No number of people affected is given.
plain: Users of Quirónsalud's patient portal are being told someone got in without permission on 16 November and took their email address. The company says it is contained.
exec: A hospital group's patient portal exposed user email addresses, which can be used for impersonation messages aimed at patients.
action: As Quirónsalud's notice asks, change your portal password as a precaution, share no passwords or verification codes, and use only the official app or usual website.
impact: Per the notice quoted by the outlet: email address extracted; passwords and medical records not mentioned; number affected not given.

validation.note: El Digital de Albacete and elDiario.es, two independent publishers, each report the email theft and the company notice; the AI and Colombia details are company sources via elDiario.es only. No Quirónsalud press release, AEPD or police page read.

review.note: title, date 16 Nov, email-only data, contained, security forces and AEPD informed, advice and single_source status against El Digital de Albacete's quoted notice
